Dear Sir/Madam,
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the ("SEBI Listing Regulations"), we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today, i.e. on 25th August, 2026 has, inter alia, considered and approved the following:
'Proposal to file an application with the Registrar of Companies (ROC) Under Section 96 of the Companies Act, 2013, seeking an extension of time for holding the 43rd Annual General Meeting of the Company for the financial year 2025-26.
